applies_to: calibration_verdict.json (sha256 recorded in prediction_C/S/R.json inputs_sha256; that file is left unchanged)
ruling: P22 §1 (2026-09-15): the instrument check passes. Basis: the disagreement is attributable and disappears when the cause is removed.

basis.cause: the reference client resolved 'localhost' on this Windows host; per-request TTFT became bimodal (17–20 ms vs 30–45 ms) plus a slow first request per run
basis.kept: the localhost runs stay in calibration_verdict.json as the control

limitation: The check compared avg, p50 and min. The SLO verdicts read p99, which was not calibrated. Verdict robustness is therefore judged per level by its boundary distance (slo_margins.json); the narrowest is profile C, interactive SLO, N=32: TTFT p99 459.8 ms vs 500 ms limit, margin 40.2 ms. Next calibration must include the statistic the verdict reads.
